newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-FERRARI CONFIRM BRAWN AS TECHNICAL DIRECTOR.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FERRARI CONFIRM BRAWN AS TECHNICAL DIRECTOR.

text.p: Italian motor racing team Ferrari on Wednesday confirmed that former Benetton designer Ross Brawn would be joining them next week.

Brawn, the man behind the successful Benetton cars that helped Michael Schumacher to the 1994 and 1995 world championship titles, had been linked with Ferrari since his departure from Benetton was made public earlier this month.
A statement from the team said Brawn would take up his appointment on December 2.
